endpoint.selection: Exact explicit Config.EndpointOverrides (cloud_1c,v2,scope), selected after discovery; no guessed regional host; base includes /v2
endpoint.ref_validation: For caller-provided refs, exact ID/URL binding match before credential lookup and HTTP; no redirect or selecting a ref-supplied endpoint

request.reference: Exact cluster ref with no parent; escaped ID, pinned endpoint; no implicit deletion of infobases
request.prerequisite: Caller must remove linked infobases beforehand per official operation description

response.mapping: Typed DeleteClusterResponse. ID/projectId must match request. Accepted receipt retains exact caller reference on response or decode error. DELETING is not deletion completion.
response.number_protection: Source JSON numbers are lexically validated and stored in onec.ProtectedNumber without precision conversion; formatting/JSON/Text redacts, Reveal is explicit

errors.mapping: Core bounded read status mapping; provider message excluded; malformed JSON ProtocolError
errors.lost_response: unknown_outcome with one attempt; no inferred ID, no list/name adoption

retry: no mutation replay on any unknown response

wait.source_states: ClusterStatus enum; ACTIVE / DELETED are respective explicit goal success, ERRORED failure; UNSPECIFIED/missing/new states unknown
wait.restrictions: Receipt-bound goal filtered by originating capability; exact ref and endpoint only

recovery.kind: exact resource observation; unknown outcome remains indeterminate; no replay or authorship inference
